description: The whole record: the YAML front matter, then the Markdown body.
title: change

Header.description: The front matter. Every field is read by the release engine or by the changelog projection; none is decoration.

schema.description: The format version of this record. A version the tool does not know is refused, never guessed.

id.description: The identity, allocated once and never reused. It fixes the file name and survives a retitle, so a changelog entry can be pointed at from a commit or an issue.

title.description: One line, in the present tense, as it appears in the changelog. What changed for the reader, not what was done to the code.

type.description: Which section of a changelog it belongs under.

impact.description: What it costs the people who already depend on this. It must not understate the contract: a record claiming `patch` for an entry the contract diff calls breaking is refused, because the changelog would then promise something the artifact does not.

released_in.description: The version this change was published in. Absent means unreleased: the change belongs to whatever the next release turns out to be, and `majordomus release prepare` stamps it. Written by the release pipeline, and by nothing else.

scopes.description: The surfaces a reader of this change cares about: `cli`, `api`, `mcp`, `cockpit`, `site`, `installer`, `layer`, `docs`. A projection groups by them; nothing validates that a scope exists, because a change may be about something the tool does not model.

contract.description: The contract entries this record accounts for, as `<surface>:<id>` — `capability:release.status`, `command:executable.release.status`, `document-kind:majordomus.change/v1`, `target:linux-x86_64-musl`. This is what makes coverage checkable: a breaking contract change no record names is a release the changelog does not explain, and `majordomus release check` refuses it.

issues.description: The issues this change closes, as the work graph names them.

pull_requests.description: The pull requests that carried it, as numbers.

commits.description: The commits that carried it, full forty-character shas.

adrs.description: The decisions behind it. Each must resolve to a record under .ai/repo/adrs/.

migration.description: The migration guidance, repository-relative. Required for a breaking change: a break without a way through it is a break nobody can follow, and `majordomus release check` refuses a release that has one.

Section.description: One section of the body, as the reader of a Markdown document meets it.

Body.description: The Markdown body: what the front matter cannot say.

sections.description: Every heading of the body, in document order, as the reader flattens it.

x-majordomus-sections.heading: Summary
x-majordomus-sections.description: What changed and why it mattered, for somebody reading the changelog months later with no memory of the work.

x-majordomus-sections.heading: Migration
x-majordomus-sections.description: What a reader has to do about it. Required in substance for a breaking change — the `migration` field names the document, and this section is the short form of it.
